title: [spec-gap][R-GATT-001/002/004/007/008] BLE GATT-to-IPSO/SenML gateway relay absent from all stacks (spec appendix-gatt-ipso K.1-K.4, K.8-K.9)
description: Appendix K (BLE GATT to IPSO/SenML Mapping) defines a gateway translation feature that no stack implements. Requirement (K.2 SHOULD): a device exposing a GATT Service SHOULD be represented as one or more IPSO Object instances, per the K.2/K.3 mapping tables. Keyword-less companions: K.4 reserves IPSO extension object IDs 26250-26299 (10-object table); K.9.1 sequential IPSO instance IDs for repeated characteristics; K.9.4 SHOULD cache last-known values + ut staleness; K.9.5 CoRE Link Format advertisement with anchor=ble:<MAC>. Evidence: zero GATT sensor-characteristic UUIDs (0x180D/0x2A37/0x181A/0x2A6E/0x2A19/0x180F etc.) in rust/, lichen/, python/src/, firmware/, c/ — all BLE code is transport (Meshtastic GATT emulation rust/lichen-meshtastic/src/gatt.rs, KISS-over-BLE, LCI SLIP python/src/lichen/gateway/ble_lci.py, IPSP lichen/subsys/lichen/transport/ble_ipsp_transport.c); rg \b2625[0-9]\b zero; no link-format anchor= attribute or rt=ipso anywhere; no BLE value cache. Partial support that exists: 7-object IPSO vocabulary (3303/3304/3313/3315/3323/3334/3336) rust/lichen-senml/src/ipso.rs:15-94 + python/src/lichen/senml/ipso.py:26-105, tested against test/vectors/ipso_smart_objects.json (python/tests/senml/test_ipso.py, rust/lichen-senml/tests/ipso_vectors.rs) — no GATT side, no production caller in Rust. Suggested placement: GATT-characteristic-to-IPSO mapping table + notification relay in lichen-senml (Rust) / lichen.senml (Python) and the C gateway BLE ingress (lichen/apps/gateway/src/), with vectors extending test/vectors/ipso_smart_objects.json. MUSTs R-GATT-003/005 filed separately.
